newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - SanMig B seen overvalued.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SanMig B seen overvalued.

text.p: Philippine Asia Equity recommended a sell on San Miguel Corp B shares on Monday saying they were overvalued.

"At 35 times this year's EPS (earnings per share), the stock is twice as expensive as the market. On P/E (price/earnings) growth ... the stock is 3.8 times as expensive as the market," analysts Gina Dipaling and Matthew Sutherland said in a report.
They said domestic beer sales, its biggest contributor, would stay stagnant this year.
"This still remains the clearest call in our market. Sell," they said.
San Miguel B shares inched up to close at 110 pesos on Monday, up 4.0 pesos from Friday's close.
